description: Experimental Piko Tor fork, based on Piko 3.9.0. Enable Tor network companion for X 12.19.1-release.0, install the separate companion APK, and configure Android always-on VPN plus lockdown. Not validated for sensitive use or complete leak prevention. Automatic post-kill recovery remains broken on the tested emulator. No detached publisher signature; SHA256SUMS verifies integrity only.
